verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat lets users ask questions in natural language, search meetings and connected apps, and generate follow-ups, reports and content. Through Otter's MCP server, users can also search, recap and draft follow-ups from Claude or ChatGPT chats. The documented natural-language scope is limited to querying and drafting; there is no evidence of operating the product itself, such as scheduling the notetaker, managing sharing or settings, or triggering integrations, by command. missing for 10: natural-language control of product actions and settings, documentation of supported commands, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
